placements.why: Establishes the organization's stratum for release gate controls and verification prerequisites across deployment pipelines.
placements.title: Enforcing Mandatory Verification Before Deployment
placements.frame: What criteria, verification checks, and approval gates must artifacts satisfy before progressing through release environments?

placements.title: Requiring Signed Manifests to Prevent Unverified Artifacts
placements.frame: How does the mandate for signed release manifests protect staging and production environments from unverified deployment artifacts?
placements.why: Quinton Fairweather establishes a mandatory gate requiring signed release manifests across staging and production to prevent unsigned artifacts from shipping on the Meridian release train.
